sections.title: **[HIGH] N+1 UPDATE in meal assignment — `meals.ts:551-558`**
sections.content:
Every pipeline run executes one `UPDATE` per meal assignment — typically 14 for a full week:

```typescript
// apps/lambdas/ai-scheduler-lambda/src/pipeline/stages/meals.ts:551-558
for (const a of assignments) {
  const updated = await db
    .update(timeBlocks)
    .set({ linkedEntityId: a.meal.id, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(and(eq(timeBlocks.id, a.placeholderId), lte(timeBlocks.updatedAt, pipelineStartedAt)))
    .returning({ id: timeBlocks.id })
  if (updated.length > 0) linkedCount += 1
}
```

**Fix:** Batch into a single `UPDATE … CASE`:

```typescript
// Build a CASE/WHEN batch update
import { sql, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm'

const linkedCount = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
  const caseExpr = sql`CASE ${sql.join(
    assignments.map((a) => sql`WHEN id = ${a.placeholderId} THEN ${a.meal.id}`),
  )} END`
  const updated = await tx
    .update(timeBlocks)
    .set({ linkedEntityId: caseExpr, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(timeBlocks.id, assignments.map((a) => a.placeholderId)),
        lte(timeBlocks.updatedAt, pipelineStartedAt),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: timeBlocks.id })
  return updated.length
})
```

Reduces 14 round-trips to 1. ~95% latency reduction for the meals stage.
